Get enriched pathways for a pixel

Source: R/utils_processing_pixelenrichment.R
preprocessing_get_enriched_pathways_perpixel.Rd

Uses local differential peaks to run ORA and return pathway results for a given spot index (row) within the sample.

Usage

preprocessing_get_enriched_pathways_perpixel(
  row,
  intensity.per.sample,
  metadata.per.sample,
  control.table,
  min.neighbours = 3,
  pvalue.cutoff = 0.05,
  lfc.cutoff = 0.5,
  test = "t-test",
  background = NULL,
  min_path_size = 3,
  ora_pvalue_cutoff = 1.01,
  min_pathway_hits = 2,
  gap = NULL,
  anno,
  pathway_table
)

Arguments

row

Integer; index (row number) within metadata.per.sample corresponding to the target spot.

intensity.per.sample

Spot-by-feature intensity matrix for the sample.

metadata.per.sample

Data frame of spot metadata for the sample (must contain x_tf, y_tf and spot_id).

control.table

Control sample intensity matrix generated by make_control_samples.

min.neighbours

Integer; minimum neighbours (unused but kept for API compatibility).

pvalue.cutoff

Numeric; adjusted p-value cutoff for DE peaks.

lfc.cutoff

Numeric; log-fold-change cutoff for DE peaks.

test

Character; statistical test to use for DE.

background

Optional background gene list for ORA.

min_path_size

Integer; minimum pathway size to consider in ORA.

ora_pvalue_cutoff

Numeric; ORA p-value cutoff.

min_pathway_hits

Integer; minimum pathway hits.

gap

Numeric; neighbourhood gap used to build the comparison set.

anno

Data frame; annotation data used by ORA/DE.

pathway_table

Data frame of pathway definitions with columns PathwayID, PathwayName, and MetaboliteIDs.

Value

Data frame of ORA results annotated with x and y coordinates, or NULL if no pathways found.
